records.label: LED cool white (~6000 K phosphor-converted)

definition.name: led_cool_white
definition.label: LED cool white (~6000 K phosphor-converted)
definition.notes: Composite: GaN die direct (30 %) + YAG:Ce phosphor (70 %). Die: Gaussian 450 nm σ=18 nm, L_c=5 µm partial coherence. Phosphor: Gaussian 545 nm σ=60 nm, fully incoherent L_c=0.05 µm.

components.name: led_cool_white.gan_die
components.label: GaN die direct (cool white)
components.notes: Blue InGaN QW die. In-plane mixed electric dipole emission I(θ)∝(1+cos²θ)/2. Partial coherence L_c=5µm.

components.name: led_cool_white.phosphor
components.label: YAG:Ce phosphor (cool white)
components.notes: YAG:Ce phosphor layer, cooler CCT. Fully incoherent, true Lambertian diffuser.
